message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on any incoming data or configuration arguments anywhere in the visible code.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code uses torchvision's built-in download for CIFAR-10 (via the download_cifar10 flag) but performs no checksum verification, signature checks, or pinned-revision controls on the downloaded data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to the training samples at any point in the data preparation or training pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The checkpoint is loaded via torch.load() from a file path with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; only a filename suffix check (.ckpt) is performed.
No detected label distribution validation: The code creates dataloaders and begins training without any check on label distribution, class balance, or expected label set before training starts.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop performs standard forward/backward passes with no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense mechanism.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a plain torch.optim.SGD with no DP wrapping (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD) applied anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD perturbations are imported or applied anywhere in the evaluation flow.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a separate test loader is used, there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, no cryptographic integrity check, and no evidence of multiple independent evaluators or audit trails to prevent metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data via DataLoader and passes it directly to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation on the inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly to the loss function or evaluation routine with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision classification model (CNN/ResNet on CIFAR-10/MNIST), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
